list: Official 55 trophies — 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze
note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list. Guides, steps and roadmap stages are written for this entry, in its own words, from the official descriptions.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. There is no separate task: work through the roadmap stages in order, save the 100% completion trophy for last, and this one pops with it. Keep the tracker on this page updated so you can see exactly which trophies are left.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order.
The platinum unlocks the moment the 54th one pops.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission of the game, so this is the first story trophy most players earn. Follow the on-screen prompts through the mission; it teaches the basic movement, driving and interaction controls. Missable only in the sense that it is tied to one story moment — finish the mission and it pops, and mission replay can recover it if the game offers it.
steps: Start a new game and play through the opening mission, Gone Fishing.
Complete every objective the mission gives you.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through every story mission in Chapter 1 in order. Chapter trophies unlock at the final mission of the chapter, so there is nothing extra to hunt: just keep following the story markers. If you are trophy hunting, finish the chapter before wandering off into side content, so the missable story trophies stay in sequence.
steps: Play the Chapter 1 story missions in order.
Finish the chapter's final mission.
The trophy pops when the chapter ends.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: The Chapter 2 completion trophy. Keep playing the story missions in order after Chapter 1; the chapter closes with its final mission and the trophy pops there. Use the time between story beats to try the activities that Chapter 2 opens up, but do not skip story missions — the chapter trophy only comes from the story path.
steps: Play the Chapter 2 story missions in order.
Finish the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: The Chapter 3 completion trophy, earned by finishing the chapter's final story mission. By this point Vice City itself is fully open, so it is tempting to drift into collectibles — that is fine, but keep the story moving too, since the later chapters gate several side strands and activities behind story progress.
steps: Play the Chapter 3 story missions in order.
Finish the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: The Chapter 4 completion trophy. Chapter 4 is the last full chapter before the finale, so finishing it also unlocks the run-up to the final mission and the gold story trophy. Stock up on ammo, armour and cash before the final stretch — the last missions rarely give you a quiet moment to shop.
steps: Play the Chapter 4 story missions in order.
Finish the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The gold trophy for finishing the story: complete the final mission. The finale is long and checkpointed, so play it when you have an uninterrupted session. Before starting it, consider clearing the missable story trophies and the partner-moment trophies, since the post-game world may not offer the same setups again.
steps: Finish Chapters 1 to 4.
Play the final mission to its end.
The gold trophy pops at the credits.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a named story mission. Play the story in order and the mission appears on your map as a letter marker; complete its objectives and the trophy pops. Because it is tied to a single mission, it is flagged missable here: if you fail or skip past it, use mission replay (if the game offers it) rather than starting over.
steps: Follow the story until the Breakfast Run marker appears.
Complete the mission's objectives.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is one of the story's big set-piece missions. It unlocks as the story reaches it; there is no side requirement to trigger it. Heists in this series usually offer a planning choice, so read the options before you commit — but the trophy itself only needs the mission completed, whichever approach you take.
steps: Follow the story until The Cartel Heist unlocks.
Complete the heist mission.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a named story mission. It appears as a story marker as you play through the chapters; finish it and the trophy pops. Like the other named-mission trophies it is flagged missable because it belongs to one mission only — keep the story moving in order and you cannot skip it by accident.
steps: Follow the story until the Child's Play marker appears.
Complete the mission's objectives.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is a named story mission in Chapter 3. Play the story in order, take the mission when its marker appears, and finish it for the trophy. The name hints at a music-scene set piece, so expect a loud, scripted sequence rather than a free-roam objective — stay on the mission's path and it resolves itself.
steps: Follow the story until the Headliners marker appears.
Complete the mission's objectives.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a named story mission set around Vice City International Airport. Follow the story until its marker appears and complete it. Airport missions usually mix driving and shooting, so bring a stocked weapon loadout and a fast car to the marker before you start, and the mission itself does the rest.
steps: Follow the story until the VCIA Takedown marker appears.
Complete the mission's objectives.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a named story mission in Chapter 4. The name suggests a heavy combat sequence, so arrive prepared: full armour, a good rifle, and snacks or supplies if the game stocks them. Finish the mission and the trophy pops; it is flagged missable because it belongs to that one mission.
steps: Follow the story until the Operation Savage Glory marker appears.
Complete the mission's objectives.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The gold trophy for 100% completion: finish the story, all stranger strands, all collectibles, all activities and every checklist item the in-game stats screen counts. This is the last trophy most players earn, right before the platinum. Track your percentage on the in-game stats screen and use this guide's checklist to find which category is holding you back — usually a handful of collectibles or one activity type.
steps: Finish the story and all side strands.
Complete every collectible set and activity the stats screen counts.
Reach 100% on the in-game completion stat.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, long airtime and other driving feats the game counts as a stunt. This is a grind best done passively: drive fast everywhere, take ramps and jumps when you see them, and the count climbs on its own across the whole playthrough. If you still need some at the end, find a long straight with jumps nearby and repeat runs in a fast car. Use the tracker's counter on this page to log your running total.
steps: Drive fast and take jumps, ramps and airtime whenever you can.
Near misses in traffic and long jumps count too.
Repeat stunt runs in a fast car to finish the last few.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — the game counts a type the first time you take part in it. Work through the activities the map offers: racing, fishing, the shooting range, drone races, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and the other open-world pastimes. One attempt each is enough, so sample everything early and this pops quickly; the dedicated trophies for each activity come later in the roadmap.
steps: Open the map and note the activity icons.
Take part in each of the 9 activity types once.
The trophy pops after the ninth type.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit a shooting range (an ammunition shop with a range, or a dedicated range) and work through the challenges weapon by weapon. Gold needs accuracy and speed, so learn each challenge's target pattern first with a slow run, then go for the gold time. Use the weapon the challenge gives you — bringing your own modded gun rarely helps — and replay any challenge freely until it turns gold.
steps: Find a shooting range and open its challenge list.
Learn each challenge's targets with a practice run.
Replay challenges until all 42 show a gold medal.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Drone races are time trials through rings: learn the course line on a first run, then cut corners through the rings on the second. The races are scattered across Leonida, so this pairs well with the exploration trophy — visit each location, win its race, and tick it off in the tracker.
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race location on the map.
Fly the course once to learn the ring line.
Win the race at all 14 locations.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race only counts once, so you need 20 distinct events across the map, not 20 wins of the same one. Use the fastest car you own, brake late, and take the racing line; street races often let you retry instantly after a loss. Work through the race icons region by region and tick each win off in the tracker so you know which ones are left.
steps: Find race markers across the map.
Win each race with a fast, upgraded car.
Win 20 different races — repeats do not count.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head: catch the target fish (or the heaviest total catch) before Cal does. Watch the line tension, reel steadily rather than mashing, and use the bait the challenge suggests. If you lose, the challenge can be retried — the trophy only needs one win.
steps: Find a fishing spot and take the challenge against Cal.
Reel steadily and watch the tension meter.
Beat Cal's catch to win the challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — play any arcade cabinet through to its end. Arcades are found in bars, malls and entertainment spots around Vice City. Pick the shortest game on the cabinet, learn its controls in the first minute, and finish a full run; a high score is not needed, only a completed game.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet in a bar or mall.
Start any game on it.
Play through to the end of a full game.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy is one of the stranger contacts with a mission strand: a chain of side missions that ends with a final mission for him. Stranger missions appear as question-mark markers; take each one when it shows up and follow the strand to its end. Side strands are not missable in the story sense — the markers stay on the map until you play them — but finish them before the finale so nothing is left hanging.
steps: Find Andy's stranger marker and take the first mission.
Play each mission in his strand as it appears.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's strand is a chain of side missions ending in a final mission for him. The title hints at boats, so expect water: keep a fast boat handy or know where to steal one near his missions. Take each mission in the strand as its marker appears and finish the last one for the trophy.
steps: Find Kenton's stranger marker and take the first mission.
Play each mission in his strand as it appears.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's strand is a chain of side missions ending in a final mission for him. The title points to bikes, so a fast motorcycle is the right tool for his missions. Work through the strand in order — each mission unlocks the next — and the trophy pops at the final one.
steps: Find Billy's stranger marker and take the first mission.
Play each mission in his strand as it appears.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers are the question-mark contacts with their own mission chains — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and others. Each strand ends with its own final-mission trophy, so this silver pops naturally once you finish eight of them. Explore the whole state, not just Vice City, since several strangers only appear in the smaller towns and countryside.
steps: Take stranger missions from question-mark markers across Leonida.
Finish each strand to its final mission.
Complete 8 strands in total.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's strand is a chain of side missions ending in a final mission for him. Supply and demand suggests moving goods, so expect delivery and pickup runs under time pressure — use a fast, sturdy vehicle and learn the route on the first attempt. Finish the strand's final mission for the trophy.
steps: Find Randy's stranger marker and take the first mission.
Play each mission in his strand as it appears.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand is a chain of side missions ending in a final mission for him. The title hints at spinning — cars, records, or both — so expect driving-heavy missions. Play the strand in order and finish its final mission for the trophy.
steps: Find Tyrone's stranger marker and take the first mission.
Play each mission in his strand as it appears.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are quiet scenic points — beaches, hilltops, parks and lookouts — marked when you get close or shown on a collectible map. Visit each one and use the meditate prompt; the trophy pops at the eighteenth. This pairs perfectly with the exploration trophy, since the spots are spread across the whole state.
steps: Find meditation spots at scenic points across Leonida.
Use the meditate prompt at each one.
Meditate at all 18 spots.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand is the hunting one: he points you at a rare animal somewhere in Leonida's wilds. Track it quietly — move slowly, watch the wind and the animal's trail, and take one clean shot rather than spraying. The unique animal only counts when Bret's hunt is active, so take the mission first and follow its clues.
steps: Take Bret's hunting strand from his stranger marker.
Follow the hunt's clues to the unique animal.
Take it down with a clean shot.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — in shops, houses, bars and out in the world — and each set is a themed group of cards. Pick up cards as you explore and check your collection menu to see which sets are close to complete; use a collectible map for the last few of each set. Three finished sets earn the silver.
steps: Pick up collectible cards as you explore.
Check the collection menu to see which sets are near complete.
Finish any 3 card sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It action at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the game's photo-tagging or check-in style collectible: find the marked spots — landmarks, signs, murals and viewpoints — and trigger the WAiNK prompt at each one. It is a long grind, so fold it into your exploration: every time you enter a new area, look for the WAiNK marker before you leave. Use the tracker's counter to keep your running total.
steps: Look for WAiNK markers at landmarks and viewpoints.
Trigger the WAiNK It prompt at each spot.
Reach 100 locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the small goals the game tracks across every activity — stunt totals, race wins, fishing catches, shooting scores and more — listed in the challenges menu. Open that menu, pick the easiest unfinished ones first, and clear them in batches; many complete themselves while you chase the other trophies. Fifty finished challenges earns the trophy.
steps: Open the challenges menu and sort by easiest.
Clear short challenges first (stunts, catches, wins).
Complete 50 challenges in total.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape. This needs a story moment or free-roam session where your partner is in the car with you: build heat to 4 stars (helicopters and heavy police response), then break line of sight and hide until the stars clear — use tunnels, the countryside, or a fast car on the highway. Flagged missable because it needs your partner present, which only happens at certain story points and in co-op style free roam with them.
steps: Play with your partner beside you (story or free roam).
Raise your wanted level to 4 stars.
Break line of sight and stay hidden until the wanted level clears.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level — the trick is the opposite of most trophies: you must keep the heat, not lose it. Plan a route of three close shops, rob each quickly, and keep moving so the police stay on you but never catch you. A fast getaway car parked outside each shop helps; do not stop to fight. Flagged missable because it needs your partner with you.
steps: Play with your partner beside you.
Pick three shops close together and plan the route.
Rob all three in a row while keeping your wanted level.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — drive or ride each new vehicle type once and it counts as discovered. Leonida is full of variety: cars, bikes, boats, planes and more, spread across city streets, the countryside and the water. Try everything you see: get in, drive a short distance, and move on. Rare vehicles hide in specific spots, so check docks, airfields and dealership lots.
steps: Get into every new vehicle you see and drive it briefly.
Check docks, airfields and dealership lots for rare types.
Discover 100 different vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus (the slow-motion aiming mode). Find a spot with a group of enemies — a gang hideout or a police-heavy shootout — trigger Combat Focus, and chain headshots quickly while time is slowed. A high-capacity automatic weapon helps; do not waste the slow-mo on one target at a time. If the focus ends early, just retry at the next group.
steps: Find a group of 5 or more enemies.
Trigger Combat Focus and chain quick headshots.
Down 5 enemies before the focus ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — Vice City International Airport. In plain terms: steal a plane from the airport and take off without a flight plan. Get onto the airfield (through a gap in the fence or a service road), board a parked plane, and get airborne before security stops you. A small fast plane is easiest; once you are in the air, the trophy pops.
steps: Get onto the VCIA airfield.
Board a parked plane.
Take off — an unscheduled departure.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description points at Rhinos — the series' military tank. The trick is to get into, or deal with, a Rhino tank: at high wanted levels the military rolls in, and Rhinos appear around bases and heavy response zones. The safest route is to steal one when you find it parked or stalled, or to take one down with sticky explosives and heavy weapons. Either way, the trophy is about the tank encounter itself.
steps: Reach a high wanted level or find a military area.
Find a Rhino tank.
Steal it or take it on — the tank encounter is the point.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. This is a stealth job: case the store first, go in quiet, avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, and get out before any alarm. Move slowly, use cover, and do not draw a weapon unless the plan has already failed — a detected run can simply be retried. Pick a small store for your first attempt.
steps: Find a jewelry store and watch its layout first.
Enter quietly and avoid cameras and staff sightlines.
Take the goods and leave without triggering an alarm.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Bank vaults are the big robberies: get in, crack the vault, grab the cash and escape the police response. Plan your getaway before you go in — a fast car nearby, a route away from the city centre — and do not linger for extra loot once the alarm is up. Five clean escapes earn the silver.
steps: Find a bank with a vault you can rob.
Crack the vault and grab the cash.
Escape the police, then repeat at 4 more banks.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around the city: follow one to a quiet stretch, block it or force it to stop, crack the rear doors, take the cash and lose the police. A sticky bomb on the rear doors is the classic approach, but any method that stops the truck works — the trophy only needs the robbery and the escape.
steps: Follow an armored truck to a quiet stretch of road.
Stop it and crack the rear doors.
Take the cash and escape the police.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — the whole state, from Vice City's districts to the small towns, swamps, beaches and countryside. The map tracks which areas you have visited, so open it and look for the grey, unvisited patches, then drive or fly through each one. This pairs with the meditation spots, WAiNK locations and vehicle discoveries, so do it as one big exploration sweep late in the game.
steps: Open the map and find the unvisited areas.
Drive or fly through each one.
Visit all 52 areas.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Gangs run hidden operations — stash houses, labs, storefronts — across Leonida, and each gang's turf has its own. Scout a gang's territory, find its operation, rob it and get out; then move on to the next gang's turf. Nine gangs, nine robberies, one trophy.
steps: Find a gang's illegal operation in its turf.
Rob it and escape.
Repeat for all 9 gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a beachfront bar or rooftop spot overlooking Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view — the trophy is a small moment, not a mission. Any beachfront drinking spot with an ocean view should trigger it; if one does not, try another bar along the beachfront.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach.
Find a beachfront bar with an ocean view.
Order a cocktail there.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — the series' signature move: drive a car straight through the showroom's front window. Pick a dealership showroom, get a car inside or line one up outside, and floor it through the glass. The trophy is a nod to the classic opening of the older games, so the bigger the crash, the better.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom.
Get a car lined up at its front window.
Drive straight through the glass and out.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — play a game of bowling there. Bowling is one of the map's activities: walk into the alley, take a lane and bowl a full game. A strike is not needed; finishing the game is what counts. The alley is also a good place to try the other activity types for the Master of None trophy.
steps: Find the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Take a lane and start a game.
Bowl through a full game.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — the description is deliberately vague, which usually means a social or co-op moment: do something together with your partner that the in-game social feed notices. In practice this means a shared activity that draws a crowd or goes viral in the game's social media: try partner activities in busy public spots and watch for the social-feed reaction.
steps: Play with your partner in a busy public spot.
Do a shared activity that draws attention.
Watch for the in-game social feed reaction.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse — PlayStation tracks a count up to 500 for this one. The count is the game's tally of meaningful choices you make: dialogue picks, mission decisions and moral calls across the story and side content. There is no shortcut: make choices whenever the game offers them, in missions and in free roam, and the tally climbs. Flagged missable because some choices only appear once, at specific story moments — always pick an option rather than walking away from a decision.
steps: Make a choice whenever the game offers one.
Play story and side missions — decisions appear in both.
Reach 500 tracked choices.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — succeed at something on your second attempt after failing it once. The natural reading: fail a mission, challenge or attempt, then pass it on the immediate retry. If it does not pop on its own during normal play, pick a short mission or challenge, fail it deliberately, then pass it on the second try. Flagged missable because it needs a fail-then-pass pair, which is easy to miss if you rarely fail.
steps: Fail a mission or challenge once.
Retry it right away.
Pass it on the second attempt.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? — the classic strange-encounter trophy. Somewhere in Leonida there is a weird event: a UFO sighting, a cryptid, or something equally out of place. These encounters usually trigger at a specific place and time (often at night, in a remote spot), so explore the odd corners of the map — the swamps, the deserted beaches, the hilltops — and the event finds you.
steps: Explore remote, odd corners of Leonida, especially at night.
Look for anything out of place — lights, sounds, strange figures.
Trigger the strange encounter.
sources: IGN — GTA 6 wiki: secrets and easter eggs

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by — knock pedestrians down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Drive slowly through a crowded area, swing a melee weapon (a bat works well) from the driver's seat, and knock someone over. It is a drive-by, but with a bat instead of a gun: speed matters less than timing, so go slow and aim the swing.
steps: Get a melee weapon and a car.
Drive slowly through a crowded area.
Swing the melee weapon from the car to knock someone over.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are dirty cash from robberies and heists; your contacts clean them for a cut. Keep robbing (bank vaults, armored trucks, gang operations all pay in marked bills), then launder the take through your contacts after each job. The total is cumulative across the whole game, so it builds steadily if you launder after every score instead of sitting on dirty cash.
steps: Earn Marked Bills from robberies and heists.
Launder them through your contacts.
Reach $250,000 laundered in total.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — weapons, clothes, cars, food, anything the shops sell. This is cumulative and almost earns itself: buy the weapons and upgrades you actually want, dress your character, and keep a car you like tuned. If you are short near the end, buy expensive items (a high-end car or weapon) and the total jumps. Spending counts across every shop type, so it all adds up.
steps: Buy weapons, clothes, cars and upgrades as you play.
Spending counts across every shop type.
Reach $100,000 spent in total.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are buyable properties that store your vehicles; they appear for sale around Leonida as you progress. Save up — properties are not cheap — and buy each one when it appears. Owning all 8 also makes the vehicle-collection trophy much easier, since you can keep the rare cars you find instead of losing them.
steps: Save cash as you play the story.
Buy each garage property when it goes on sale.
Own all 8 garage properties.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Scooter Bros is the in-game delivery and vehicle app: open it, register a vehicle you own or have found, and repeat for 10 different vehicles. Any vehicle type counts, so register the cars and bikes you drive most — and the odd ones you discover while hunting the 100-vehicle trophy, since the two trophies share the same habit.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app.
Register a vehicle you own or found.
Register 10 different vehicles.
